resources.string: Discuss in this order for the configured rounds. Bot @mentions temporarily take priority, then the remaining order resumes. Your direct @mentions select only those members for one round.
Use saved member order, with existing bot handoffs and turn limits.
Summarize once after every whole-group round completes successfully. The summary counts toward the turn limit. No summary after failure, cancellation or an unconfirmed send.
Could not save group order. The previous order is kept. Reconnect and save again.
1–10 rounds. Mentioning a member who has not spoken moves their turn forward in this round. Mentioning a member who already spoke adds a bounded handoff.
Turn limit: %1$d. Includes all rounds, handoffs and the summary. PASS also counts as a turn. This is separate from the round count.
Additional handoff limit: %1$d. Applies across all rounds to members who already spoke. Remaining scheduled turns continue when this limit is reached.
